verdict.rationale: Tilled documents merchant pricing managed through pricing templates created in the Dashboard. That implies the platform can set per-seller pricing, which is one leg of the story. Nothing in the pack shows an explicit application fee or markup on each transaction, or reporting that separates platform payments revenue from processing costs. Missing for 10: explicit per-transaction application fee/markup mechanism, revenue-vs-cost reporting, detail on how pricing templates translate into platform margin, independent corroboration.
